node.title: Exact rate-half safe bracket from Haboeck's quadratic Johnson MCA theorem
node.closure: published theorem specialization with exact integer replay
node.statement: For n=2^41, k=2^40 and B*=floor(q/2^128), define Q_m=floor(sqrt((2m+1)^14 n^7/(384^2(k-1)^3))) and a_m=ceil(((2m+1)/(2m))sqrt(n(k-1))). Haboeck's proved quadratic theorem gives B_mca(a_m)<=Q_m, so Q_m<=B* is an exact safe-side certificate. Because Q_m is nondecreasing and unbounded while a_m is nonincreasing, the largest affordable m gives the strongest agreement at fixed budget, and the least m with a_m<=s gives the smallest certified numerator at fixed support s, among the printed theorem family. The first strict improvement over 3n/4 is m=9 at log2(q)>=232.650530. Under q<2^256 the maximal affordable member is m=95, with a_95=1563128173124 and radius 635895082428; m=96 is impossible. Every razor row q>2^255.9 receives at least the m=94 bracket, upgrading to m=95 at q>=330298791207625937408605578064099942258*2^128. This narrows but does not locate the adjacent crossing or supply a support-sensitive improvement between theorem thresholds.
